svg.desc: DFMEA failure chains, sheet 3 of 3 (DFM rev 0.13): failure modes DFM-014 to DFM-018 (5 failure modes, 7 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-4 · DFMEA failure chains — sheet 3 of 3
DFM rev 0.13 · BL-007 · draft · DFM-014 … DFM-018 · 7 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
Connect the device to the vehicle buses,
power and ignition, and report harness
Ignition sense reads on when the ignition is off
End effect: Longer actuation window after SoC loss
Ignition-sense transistor Q6 (DMN3200U, harness box) drain-source
heartbeat between SoC and MCU intact;
keep the MCU running the signed
End effect: Wrong in-envelope actuation, or a wrong configuration
Bit errors on the SPI link (EMC, signal integrity); 8-bit XOR only, no
MCU forced into the ROM bootloader or reflashed by the
End effect: Any actuation hazard (unverified image), or loss of
SoC drives STM_BOOT0/STM_RST_N (fault or compromise); no
RDP/WRP; pandad recovery flashes a development bootstub
Sound a warning when the SoC is lost
while engaged, independently of the SoC
No SoC-independent warning on SoC loss
End effect: Loss of control without timely warning
Siren shares the codec, amplifier or speaker with the SoC audio,
which the faulty SoC powers down
Siren path fault stays latent (no self-test)
Keep the device mechanically secured and
MCU runs above its temperature rating
End effect: Unintended actuation or loss of control
Sun-loaded windscreen enclosure plus SoC heat; fan stall; MCU

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
